name: Uniform-Fiber and Minimal-Non-Ample-Parent Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite concept classes, after suppressing fixed coordinates.
statement: Topal fibers of finite uniform oriented matroids, with cubes included, are exactly the cubes and nonempty iterated conditionings of conditioning-minimal non-ample parents.
proof: The classification of conditioning-minimal non-ample parents identifies their nontrivial simple members with non-free uniform-oriented-matroid tope sets. Their iterated conditionings are precisely nonempty topal fibers; the rank-one boundary cases are cubes.
